headline: SPRINGPOLE EA APPROVED: FEDERAL GREEN LIGHT FOR CANADA'S LANDMARK ONTARIO GOLD DEPOSIT AFTER 8-YEAR REVIEW (TSX:FF)
source_name: PR Newswire / First Mining Gold Corp.
snippet: Federal Environment Minister Julie Aviva Dabrusin approved the Environmental Assessment for First Mining Gold's Springpole Gold Project on June 30, 2026 — clearing an 8-year regulatory process for one of Canada's largest undeveloped gold and silver deposits, located approximately 110 km northeast of Red Lake, Ontario, with a proposed 12-year open-pit mine life. Subject to provincial conditions, First Mining (TSX:FF) can now advance Springpole toward construction, a milestone that could unlock billions in projected GDP and hundreds of jobs in northwestern Ontario.

headline: JIAMA COPPER RESERVE UP 1,170%: CHINA GOLD INTERNATIONAL POSTS TRANSFORMATIONAL TIBET RESOURCE UPDATE (TSX:CGG)
source_name: Investing News Network / China Gold International
snippet: China Gold International Resources (TSX:CGG) completed a transformational Mineral Resource and Reserve update for the Jiama Copper Polymetallic Project in Tibet on June 30, 2026, with Measured Mineral Resources increasing 523% and Proven Mineral Reserves surging 1,170% — dramatically extending mine life and development scope for the porphyry copper-molybdenum-gold-silver-lead-zinc system. The company guided 2026 copper production of 140–149 million pounds from Jiama, now on a materially expanded resource base.

headline: BRIXTON METALS DRILLS 8.33% CU, 971 g/t AG OVER 1.5M AT GLENFIDDICH — NEAR-SURFACE HIT IN GOLDEN TRIANGLE (TSXV:BBB)
snippet: Brixton Metals Corp. (TSXV:BBB) released initial 2026 drill results on June 30 at the Camp Creek Corridor of its wholly owned Thorn Project in northwestern BC, with hole THN26-372 returning 14.75 metres of 1.25% copper, 1.71 g/t gold, and 149 g/t silver from 84.25 metres depth — including a high-grade core of 1.50 metres at 8.33% Cu, 11.30 g/t Au, and 971 g/t Ag. Near-surface polymetallic hits at the Glenfiddich Zone bolster the project's high-sulphidation gold system within the BC Golden Triangle's fully funded 10,000-metre 2026 drill program.

headline: 3.51 g/t AU OVER 21M AT NYAM — NEWCORE EXTENDS HIGH-GRADE GOLD BELOW RESERVE ENVELOPE IN GHANA'S ENCHI (TSXV:NCAU)
snippet: Newcore Gold (TSXV:NCAU) reported June 30, 2026 results from 11 diamond drill holes at the Nyam Gold Deposit at the Enchi Gold Project in Ghana, with hole NBDD086 intersecting 3.51 g/t Au over 21.0 metres — including 5.91 g/t Au over 9.0 metres — from 245 metres depth below the pit-constrained reserve envelope. All 283 holes completed to date (44,651 metres total) have intersected gold mineralisation, with the ongoing 80,000-metre program targeting expansion of Enchi's existing 1.055-million-ounce Probable Reserve.

headline: BLOSSOM GOLD: 41M AT 0.385 g/t AU AND 18.3M AT 0.794 g/t IN NEVADA ROSEBUD HEAP-LEACH EXPANSION (TSX:BGAU)
snippet: Blossom Gold Inc. (TSX:BGAU) announced initial 2026 exploration results on June 30 at the Rosebud Open-Pit, Heap-Leach Project in Pershing County, Nevada, with holes BG26-002 returning 41.2 metres at 0.385 g/t Au from 19.8 metres and BG26-005 returning 18.3 metres at 0.794 g/t Au from 126.5 metres — confirming open-pit expansion potential and supporting resource definition at a permitted, road-accessible Nevada gold project.

headline: GOLD CYCLE INDICATOR AT 23 — MOST OVERSOLD SINCE LATE 2022: ANALYST MAPS FIRST TWO WEEKS OF JULY AS FINAL BOTTOM WINDOW
snippet: FXEmpire's July 1, 2026 technical gold analysis reports the Gold Cycle Indicator has collapsed to 23 — the most oversold reading since late 2022 and triggering a 'Maximum Bottoming' signal — with gold and miners now trading inside previously identified target zones with the correction approximately 95% complete. The analysis projects an ideal gold floor above $3,800 and treats the first one to two weeks of July as the critical window for a meaningful low that is expected to hold through the remainder of the secular bull market.

headline: TD SECURITIES: GOLD DROPS TO SUB-$3,900 BEFORE $5,300 RALLY IN 2027 — HORMUZ OIL SHOCK RISK THE KEY DOWNSIDE THREAT
snippet: TD Securities' head of commodity research Bart Melek warned on June 29, 2026 that gold will likely fall below $3,900 per ounce before finding a durable floor — with the primary downside risk being a Brent crude rebound toward $90–$110/bbl from Hormuz supply disruption that would re-ignite PCE inflation and reinforce September rate-hike pricing. The bank's longer-term outlook remains firmly bullish, projecting gold to average US$5,350/oz by Q2 2027, a 34%-plus gain from current levels near $3,975.

headline: VOTE TOMORROW: GORO SHAREHOLDERS DECIDE ON GOLDGROUP DEAL — DON DAVID MINE PLUS TWO MEXICO GOLD OPERATIONS (NYSE:GORO)
snippet: Gold Resource Corporation (NYSE:GORO) holds its special shareholder meeting on July 2, 2026 to vote on a reverse triangular merger with Goldgroup Mining that combines GORO's operating Don David Gold Mine in Oaxaca, Mexico with Goldgroup's San Francisco and Cerro Prieto mines — existing GORO shareholders expected to own approximately 40% of the combined company. The deal, signed January 25, 2026 and amended May 15, requires a majority of outstanding shares to pass.

headline: 1.71% CU IN SURFACE ROCKS, STRONG SOIL ANOMALY: SALAZAR RESOURCES TARGETS MONJA PORPHYRY, ECUADOR (CSE:SRL)
snippet: Salazar Resources Ltd. (CSE:SRL) reported June 30, 2026 surface exploration results at the Monja Copper-Gold Porphyry Project in Ecuador, with rock samples returning up to 1.71% copper across a large open-ended geochemical soil anomaly coincident with porphyry-style alteration — further defining drill targets in a district where major companies are advancing adjacent copper-gold porphyry systems.

headline: TOMBSTONE GOLD BELT: T2 METALS LAUNCHES Q3 MULTI-DISCIPLINE PROGRAM AT SHANGHAI AND AURORA YUKON PROJECTS (TSXV:TWO)
source_name: Investing News Network / T2 Metals Corp.
snippet: T2 Metals Corp. (TSXV:TWO) mobilized field crews to its Shanghai and Aurora gold-silver projects covering 100-plus square kilometres in the Yukon's Tombstone Gold Belt — the same prolific belt hosting Hecla Mining's Keno Hill (North America's highest-grade silver mine) and Banyan Gold's AurMac gold deposit. The Q3 2026 program encompasses airborne surveys, soil and rock sampling, geophysics, and both RAB and diamond drilling to advance both projects toward systematic drill testing.
